title: Notices sent to 6 Jamia students for organising canteen protest

ai.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia served showcause notices to six students for allegedly holding an unauthorised protest at the central canteen to oppose the Supreme Court's ruling in the Bilkis Bano case, which suspended life sentences of two convicts.

facts.claim: Jamia Millia Islamia served showcause notices to atleast six students
facts.quote: Jamia Millia Islamia has served showcause notices to atleast six students over an alleged unauthorised gathering at the university’s central canteen to protest the Supreme Court’s recent ruling in the Bilkis Bano case

facts.claim: protest was held at a non-designated location
facts.quote: Saying that the protest was held at a non-designated location, the university administration has given the students two days to explain why disciplinary action should not be taken against them.

facts.claim: protest organised by Congress-backed National Students’ Union of India (NSUI)
facts.quote: The Congress-backed National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) had organised a protest on November 23, with around 100 students gathering at JMI’s central canteen in the North Campus to condemn the SC’s order regarding the release of two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case.

facts.claim: protest aimed at opposing Supreme Court's ruling in Bilkis Bano case
facts.quote: You along with a large group of other students associated with different political outfits assembled near the central canteen…for the solidarity gathering for Bilkis Bano against the recent order of the supreme court granting ball and suspending the life sentences of two convicts in her case

facts.claim: university designated specific space for dissent
facts.quote: A JMI spokesperson said that the university has designated a specific space for dissent to ensure that routine activities are not disrupted while also providing students with a democratic platform to exercise their freedom of expression.

facts.claim: central canteen is not a designated site for protests
facts.quote: The central canteen is not a designated site for protests. It is a place where our departments and teaching blocks are located. It disturbs classes and besides exams are due shortly,

ai.background_note: Jamia Millia Islamia has designated a specific location for student protests within a democratic framework, but the central canteen was used for an unauthorised gathering to protest the Supreme Court's ruling in the Bilkis Bano case.
